quotes.text: "The embedded image should be served with its declared MIME type"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original change adds the part content type to the related resource URL so the declared SVG type can reach raw-part loading. The accepted helper uses URLParams to set and serialize type and filename. With inline attachments disabled, the regression test asserts decoded SVG bytes and channel contentType; later assertions also check the two URL parameters. These checks do not render SVG pixels or prove all protocol/channel parsers. No test or parser ran here.
title: Related SVG URLs retain the declared type, while the regression checks bytes and channel metadata
